about: ICCO Quarterly Bulletin of Cocoa Statistics (QBCS) headline world balance, as published in ICCO's free press releases (thousand tonnes; cocoa year Oct-Sep). Surplus/deficit = production minus grindings minus a 1% loss-in-weight allowance. The full bulletin (by country) is paid. Update when a new bulletin is released (end of Feb, May, Aug/Sep, Nov).

releases.label: Aug 2026 QBCS
releases.note: ICCO withheld its 2025/26 production and grindings figures in this bulletin

origins.role: ~35-40% of world beans; Conseil Café-Cacao (CCC) fixes the farmgate price each October and April and sells forward
origins.watch: weekly port arrivals (Abidjan, San-Pédro) vs last season; main-crop farmgate price; forward sales pace

origins.role: second in Africa; COCOBOD fixes farmgate prices and finances purchases with forward sales/syndicated loans
origins.watch: COCOBOD purchases and financing; smuggling across borders when farmgate prices lag; swollen shoot and illegal mining (galamsey)

origins.role: fastest-growing origin (CCN-51 and fine flavour); now rivals Ghana
liberalised markets: farmers sell at world-linked prices
smaller origins; Brazil also a large grinder
